note: 54 mm metal sleeve references, OD10 / ID6.6. Limit shell compression under closure preload; not a metal brake-torque skeleton.

label: Load-spreading washers

label: Direct shaft hub
note: Metal hub required for operation. Bore, key, clamping and axial retention unresolved; no functional hub STL released.
